name: workflow-mods
description: Small Claude Code mods for shipping, deploy verification, session status, usage limits and prompt-cache management.

plugins.name: all-mods
plugins.description: Everything in one install: ship-it, deploy-verifier, where-are-we, close-out-check, usage-guard and cache-keeper. Install this OR the individual mods, never both.

plugins.name: ship-it
plugins.description: Expands a bare 'deploy it' / 'ship it' / 'merge it' into the full commit-PR-merge-deploy-verify checklist.

plugins.name: deploy-verifier
plugins.description: After a push/merge/deploy, shows CI status and whether the new version is actually live.

plugins.name: where-are-we
plugins.description: Session-start snapshot of branch, PR, gh auth and dev servers; /where hands it to Claude.

plugins.name: close-out-check
plugins.description: Flags a stale CHANGELOG, version or handoff note after a turn that changed code.

plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Rate-limit usage in the status line; warns and blocks agent fan-out near a limit.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Prompt-cache clock with Refresh, Compress, idle cap and a new-session guard.
